title: Symbolic Computation Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Algebraic manipulation, simplification rules, and computer algebra examples. The Symbolic Computation Database documents exact mathematics by machine: manipulating expressions symbolically (not numerically) — simplifying, differentiating, integrating, solving equations, factoring polynomials — with the rewrite rules made explicit. A numerical answer tells you what; a symbolic answer tells you why. Records include simplification rule sets, worked derivations, solver methods, and the edge cases where symbolic methods fail and numerics take over.

title: Symbolic Computation Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Representation: expressions as trees (operators as nodes, atoms as leaves). Core operations: expand (distribute), factor (reverse), collect (group by variable), simplify (canonical form via rule ordering), differentiate (chain/product/quotient rules recursively), integrate (pattern matching + Risch algorithm theory; in practice heuristic). Solving: linear systems (Gaussian elimination), polynomial (factor + formula up to degree 4; numerical beyond), transcendental (isolate + special functions, e.g. Lambert W). Rule application: term rewriting with strategies (innermost/outermost); confluence matters — different rule orders should reach the same normal form. Gotchas: branch cuts (sqrt(x^2) = |x|, not x); division by zero in cancellations; floating-point contamination of exact computation.

demo.title: Execution: numerical integration vs analytic
demo.code: function trap(f,a,b,n){const h=(b-a)/n;let s=(f(a)+f(b))/2;for(let i=1;i<n;i++)s+=f(a+i*h);return s*h;}const num=trap(x=>x*x,0,2,10000);const exact=8/3;const err=Math.abs(num-exact);J({num:+num.toFixed(6),exact:+exact.toFixed(6),err:+err.toExponential(1)});assert(err<1e-6,'integration');

demo.title: Verification: BFS shortest path
demo.code: const g={a:['b','c'],b:['a','d'],c:['a','d'],d:['b','c','e'],e:['d']};function bfs(s,t){const q=[[s]],seen=new Set([s]);while(q.length){const p=q.shift();const n=p[p.length-1];if(n===t)return p;for(const m of g[n])if(!seen.has(m)){seen.add(m);q.push([...p,m]);}}}const path=bfs('a','e');J({path});assert(JSON.stringify(path)==='["a","b","d","e"]','bfs');

demo.title: Verification: uncertainty propagation analytic vs Monte Carlo
demo.code: let seed=7;function rnd(){seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return seed/0x7fffffff;}const L=10,sL=0.2,W=5,sW=0.1;const analytic=L*W*Math.sqrt((sL/L)**2+(sW/W)**2);let sum=0,sum2=0,N=50000;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const l=L+sL*(rnd()+rnd()+rnd()-1.5)*2;const w=W+sW*(rnd()+rnd()+rnd()-1.5)*2;const a=l*w;sum+=a;sum2+=a*a;}const mc=Math.sqrt(sum2/N-(sum/N)**2);J({analytic:+analytic.toFixed(3),mc:+mc.toFixed(3)});assert(Math.abs(analytic-mc)<0.15,'uq');

demo.title: Connection: simulation convergence study
demo.code: function sim(dt){let y=0,vy=50*Math.sin(Math.PI/6);const g=9.81;const T=5;for(let t=0;t<T;t+=dt){vy-=g*dt;y+=vy*dt;}return y;}const exact=50*Math.sin(Math.PI/6)*5-0.5*9.81*25;const e1=Math.abs(sim(0.02)-exact),e2=Math.abs(sim(0.01)-exact),e3=Math.abs(sim(0.005)-exact);const order=Math.log2(e1/e2);J({exact:+exact.toFixed(3),e1:+e1.toExponential(2),e2:+e2.toExponential(2),order:+order.toFixed(2)});assert(order>0.8&&order<1.3,'convergence');
